## Overview

This analysis integrates transcriptome (edgeR) and metabolome (Metabolon) data from
liver tissue of **Rps2-A226Y mutant** vs wildtype female mice at two timepoints:
**9 months** and **15 months** of age. We examine coordinated pathway-level changes
across both omics layers.

> **Note on age labels**: The original data files are labelled "6m" and "12m",
> but the actual cohort ages are 9 months and 15 months respectively. We use the
> corrected labels throughout.

## Libraries

```{r}
#| label: load-libraries
#| echo: true

# Load core packages for data wrangling and visualization
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
source(here("R", "plot_theme.R"))
library(readxl)
library(pals)
library(patchwork)
library(ggrepel)
library(scales)
```

## Data Loading

We have four input files: metabolomics and transcriptomics for each of two timepoints.
The metabolomics platforms differ in column layout between timepoints; the
transcriptomics files share a common edgeR output format.

### 9-Month Metabolomics

The 9m file has a sub-header in row 2 that must be skipped. The Super Pathway and
Sub Pathway columns use a grouped layout where empty cells inherit from the row above.

```{r}
#| label: load-met-9m
#| echo: true

# Read 9m metabolomics CSV, skipping the sub-header row
met_9m_raw <- read_delim(
  here("input", "Liver 6m mice metabolomics mut vs wt differential analysis.csv"),
  delim = ";",
  skip = 2,
  col_names = c("super_pathway", "sub_pathway", "biochemical",
                "comp_id", "kegg", "hmdb", "pubchem",
                "fold_change", "p_value", "q_value"),
  col_types = cols(
    super_pathway = col_character(),
    sub_pathway   = col_character(),
    biochemical   = col_character(),
    comp_id       = col_character(),
    kegg          = col_character(),
    hmdb          = col_character(),
    pubchem       = col_character(),
    fold_change   = col_double(),
    p_value       = col_double(),
    q_value       = col_double()
  )
)

# Forward-fill grouped pathway columns and compute log2 FC
met_9m <- met_9m_raw %>%
  fill(super_pathway, sub_pathway, .direction = "down") %>%
  filter(!is.na(biochemical), !is.na(fold_change)) %>%
  mutate(
    log2fc       = log2(fold_change),
    neg_log10p   = -log10(pmax(p_value, 1e-10)),
    significant  = p_value < 0.05,
    timepoint    = "9m"
  )

cat("9m metabolomics:", nrow(met_9m), "metabolites,",
    sum(met_9m$significant), "significant (p < 0.05)\n")
```

### 15-Month Metabolomics

The 15m file has a simpler 5-column layout with no sub-header row.

```{r}
#| label: load-met-15m
#| echo: true

# Read 15m metabolomics CSV (straightforward 5-column format)
met_15m <- read_delim(
  here("input", "Liver 12m mice metabolomics mut vs wt differential analysis.csv"),
  delim = ";",
  col_types = cols(
    biochemical  = col_character(),
    mainpathway  = col_character(),
    subpathway   = col_character(),
    `12 Months`  = col_double(),
    `p-value`    = col_double()
  )
) %>%
  rename(
    super_pathway = mainpathway,
    sub_pathway   = subpathway,
    fold_change   = `12 Months`,
    p_value       = `p-value`
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(biochemical), !is.na(fold_change)) %>%
  mutate(
    log2fc       = log2(fold_change),
    neg_log10p   = -log10(pmax(p_value, 1e-10)),
    significant  = p_value < 0.05,
    timepoint    = "15m"
  )

cat("15m metabolomics:", nrow(met_15m), "metabolites,",
    sum(met_15m$significant), "significant (p < 0.05)\n")
```

### 9-Month Transcriptomics

```{r}
#| label: load-tx-9m
#| echo: true

# Read 9m transcriptomics from edgeR Excel output
tx_9m <- read_excel(
  here("input", "custom edgeR output 6M mice Mut v Wtcr transcriptome.xlsx"),
  sheet = 1
) %>%
  rename(
    gene_name = gene_name,
    log2fc    = `log2 Ratio`,
    p_value   = pValue,
    fdr       = fdr
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(gene_name)) %>%
  # Remove Excel date-converted gene names (e.g. Sep1 -> date)
  filter(is.character(gene_name)) %>%
  mutate(
    neg_log10p  = -log10(pmax(p_value, 1e-10)),
    significant = fdr < 0.05,
    timepoint   = "9m"
  )

cat("9m transcriptomics:", nrow(tx_9m), "genes,",
    sum(tx_9m$significant), "significant (FDR < 0.05)\n")
```

## Pathway–Gene–Metabolite Mapping

We define six key biological pathways relevant to liver mistranslation response.
Each pathway maps curated gene lists (from KEGG/Reactome) to metabolite
sub-pathway annotations from the Metabolon platform.

## Pathway-Level Summaries

For each pathway we count how many genes/metabolites are found and significant,
and compute the mean log2 FC of the significant features. This provides the
data underlying the pathway overview figures.

```{r}
#| label: pathway-summary-function
#| echo: true

# Aggregate omics data at the pathway level for a given timepoint
build_pathway_summary <- function(tx_data, met_data, pathway_map) {
  map_dfr(names(pathway_map), function(pw_name) {
    pw <- pathway_map[[pw_name]]

    # Match genes (case-insensitive)
    tx_match <- tx_data %>%
      filter(tolower(gene_name) %in% tolower(pw$genes))
    tx_sig <- tx_match %>% filter(significant)

    # Match metabolites by sub-pathway
    met_match <- met_data %>%
      filter(sub_pathway %in% pw$met_subpathways)
    met_sig <- met_match %>% filter(significant)

    tibble(
      pathway         = pw_name,
      n_genes_found   = nrow(tx_match),
      n_genes_sig     = nrow(tx_sig),
      mean_gene_log2fc = if (nrow(tx_sig) > 0) mean(tx_sig$log2fc) else 0,
      n_met_found     = nrow(met_match),
      n_met_sig       = nrow(met_sig),
      mean_met_log2fc = if (nrow(met_sig) > 0) mean(met_sig$log2fc) else 0
    )
  })
}
```

```{r}
#| label: pathway-summaries
#| echo: true

# Compute pathway summaries for both timepoints
pw_summary_9m  <- build_pathway_summary(tx_9m, met_9m, pathway_map)
pw_summary_15m <- build_pathway_summary(tx_15m, met_15m, pathway_map)

pw_summary_15m %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "15-month pathway-level summary", digits = 3)
```

## Figure 1–2: Pathway Butterfly Charts {.tabset}

Butterfly charts display the mean log2 FC of significant genes (left) and
metabolites (right) for each pathway, with annotations showing the number of
significant features out of total found.

```{r}
#| label: butterfly-chart-function
#| echo: true

# Reusable function for pathway butterfly plots
plot_pathway_butterfly <- function(pw_data, timepoint_label) {
  # Reshape for dual-panel plotting
  pw_long <- pw_data %>%
    mutate(pathway = fct_rev(fct_inorder(pathway))) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(mean_gene_log2fc, mean_met_log2fc),
      names_to = "omics", values_to = "mean_log2fc"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      omics_label = if_else(omics == "mean_gene_log2fc",
                            "Transcriptome\n(FDR < 0.05)",
                            "Metabolome\n(p < 0.05)"),
      n_sig   = if_else(omics == "mean_gene_log2fc", n_genes_sig, n_met_sig),
      n_found = if_else(omics == "mean_gene_log2fc", n_genes_found, n_met_found),
      direction = case_when(
        mean_log2fc > 0 ~ "Up",
        mean_log2fc < 0 ~ "Down",
        TRUE            ~ "None"
      )
    )

  ggplot(pw_long, aes(x = mean_log2fc, y = pathway, fill = direction)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.65, alpha = 0.85) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = paste0(n_sig, "/", n_found),
          hjust = if_else(mean_log2fc >= 0, -0.15, 1.15)),
      size = POST_LABEL_SIZE, fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey50", linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(Up = "#d95f02", Down = "#1b9e77", None = "#999999"),
      guide  = "none"
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ omics_label, scales = "free_x") +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Rps2-A226Y Mutant vs WT: Pathway-Level Changes (",
                      timepoint_label, ")"),
      subtitle = "Liver, female mice",
      x = expression("Mean " * log[2] * " Fold Change (significant features)"),
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_post() +
    theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
      strip.text    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}
```

## Figure 3–4: Gene–Metabolite Dot Plots {.tabset}

Dot plots show individual significant genes (squares) and metabolites (circles)
within each pathway. Dot size reflects significance (−log10 p/FDR), and colour
indicates direction of change.

```{r}
#| label: detail-data-function
#| echo: true

# Collect individual significant genes and metabolites per pathway
build_detail_data <- function(tx_data, met_data, pathway_map, max_met = 10) {
  map_dfr(names(pathway_map), function(pw_name) {
    pw <- pathway_map[[pw_name]]

    # Significant genes in this pathway
    gene_rows <- tx_data %>%
      filter(tolower(gene_name) %in% tolower(pw$genes), significant) %>%
      transmute(
        pathway  = pw_name,
        name     = gene_name,
        type     = "Gene",
        log2fc   = log2fc,
        sig_metric = -log10(pmax(fdr, 1e-10))
      )

    # Significant metabolites in this pathway (top N by p-value)
    met_rows <- met_data %>%
      filter(sub_pathway %in% pw$met_subpathways, significant) %>%
      slice_min(p_value, n = max_met, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
      transmute(
        pathway  = pw_name,
        name     = biochemical,
        type     = "Metabolite",
        log2fc   = log2fc,
        sig_metric = neg_log10p
      )

    bind_rows(gene_rows, met_rows)
  })
}
```

```{r}
#| label: dot-plot-function
#| echo: true

# Reusable dot plot for gene-metabolite detail view
plot_gene_metabolite_dots <- function(detail_data, timepoint_label,
                                     pathway_order = NULL) {
  if (nrow(detail_data) == 0) {
    return(ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
                               label = "No significant features found"))
  }

  if (is.null(pathway_order)) {
    pathway_order <- unique(detail_data$pathway)
  }

  # Build plotting dataframe with y-positions
  plot_df <- detail_data %>%
    mutate(
      pathway = factor(pathway, levels = pathway_order),
      direction = if_else(log2fc > 0, "Up", "Down"),
      shape_type = if_else(type == "Gene", "Gene (FDR < 0.05)",
                           "Metabolite (p < 0.05)"),
      # Truncate long metabolite names
      label = if_else(nchar(name) > 35, paste0(substr(name, 1, 32), "..."), name)
    ) %>%
    arrange(pathway, type, log2fc) %>%
    mutate(y_pos = row_number())

  # Add small gaps between pathways
  pw_offsets <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(pathway) %>%
    summarise(start = min(y_pos), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(offset = (row_number() - 1) * 1.5)

  plot_df <- plot_df %>%
    left_join(pw_offsets, by = "pathway") %>%
    mutate(y_pos = y_pos + offset)

  # Background shading per pathway
  pw_bounds <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(pathway) %>%
    summarise(ymin = min(y_pos) - 0.5, ymax = max(y_pos) + 0.5,
              ymid = mean(y_pos), .groups = "drop")

  ggplot(plot_df) +
    # Horizontal separators between pathway blocks
    geom_hline(data = pw_bounds,
               aes(yintercept = ymax),
               color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3) +
    # Dot layer
    geom_point(
      aes(x = log2fc, y = y_pos,
          size = sig_metric, fill = direction, shape = shape_type),
      alpha = 0.8, stroke = 0.4, color = "black"
    ) +
    # Pathway labels
    geom_label(data = pw_bounds,
               aes(x = min(plot_df$log2fc) - 0.3, y = ymid, label = pathway),
               size = POST_LABEL_SIZE, fontface = "bold", hjust = 0,
               fill = "white", label.size = 0.3, alpha = 0.9) +
    # Reference line
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey50", linetype = "dashed") +
    # Y-axis labels
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = plot_df$y_pos,
      labels = plot_df$label,
      expand = expansion(mult = 0.02)
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("Gene (FDR < 0.05)" = 22,
                                  "Metabolite (p < 0.05)" = 21)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(Up = "#d95f02", Down = "#1b9e77")) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 8),
                          name = expression(-log[10] * "(p / FDR)")) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Gene–Metabolite Changes by Pathway (", timepoint_label, ")"),
      subtitle = "Rps2-A226Y Mutant vs WT, Liver, female mice",
      x = expression(log[2] ~ "Fold Change (Mutant / WT)"),
      y = NULL, shape = NULL, fill = "Direction"
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_post() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "vertical"
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5)))
}
```

## Metabolite Pathway Enrichment

We test whether metabolites within each sub-pathway are systematically shifted
relative to the background using two complementary approaches:
**Over-Representation Analysis (ORA)** via Fisher's exact test, and
**Quantitative Enrichment Analysis (QEA)** via Wilcoxon rank-sum test.

### Over-Representation Analysis (ORA)

ORA tests whether a pathway contains a disproportionate number of significant
metabolites compared to chance.

```{r}
#| label: ora-function
#| echo: true

# Fisher's exact ORA on metabolite sub-pathways
run_metabolite_ora <- function(met_data, pval_col = "p_value",
                               pathway_col = "sub_pathway",
                               sig_threshold = 0.05, min_size = 2) {
  total_sig    <- sum(met_data[[pval_col]] < sig_threshold)
  total_nonsig <- nrow(met_data) - total_sig

  met_data %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(pathway_col))) %>%
    summarise(
      n_total = n(),
      n_sig   = sum(.data[[pval_col]] < sig_threshold),
      mean_log2fc = mean(log2fc[.data[[pval_col]] < sig_threshold], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(n_total >= min_size) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      fisher_p = fisher.test(
        matrix(c(n_sig, total_sig - n_sig,
                 n_total - n_sig, total_nonsig - (n_total - n_sig)),
               nrow = 2),
        alternative = "greater"
      )$p.value,
      direction = if_else(mean_log2fc > 0, "Up", "Down")
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(fisher_fdr = p.adjust(fisher_p, method = "BH")) %>%
    arrange(fisher_p)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: ora-results
#| echo: true

# Run ORA for both timepoints
ora_9m  <- run_metabolite_ora(met_9m)
ora_15m <- run_metabolite_ora(met_15m)

cat("--- 9m ORA top pathways (Fisher p < 0.1) ---\n")
ora_9m %>%
  filter(fisher_p < 0.1) %>%
  dplyr::select(sub_pathway, n_total, n_sig, mean_log2fc, fisher_p, fisher_fdr) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 4)
```

### Quantitative Enrichment Analysis (QEA)

QEA tests whether the fold-change distribution of metabolites within a pathway
differs from the background (all other metabolites) using a Wilcoxon rank-sum test.

```{r}
#| label: qea-function
#| echo: true

# Wilcoxon rank-sum QEA on metabolite sub-pathways
run_metabolite_qea <- function(met_data, pathway_col = "sub_pathway",
                                min_size = 3) {
  pathways <- met_data %>%
    count(across(all_of(pathway_col))) %>%
    filter(n >= min_size) %>%
    pull(1)

  map_dfr(pathways, function(pw) {
    pw_fc <- met_data %>%
      filter(.data[[pathway_col]] == pw) %>%
      pull(log2fc)
    bg_fc <- met_data %>%
      filter(.data[[pathway_col]] != pw) %>%
      pull(log2fc)

    wt <- wilcox.test(pw_fc, bg_fc)

    tibble(
      pathway      = pw,
      n            = length(pw_fc),
      mean_log2fc  = mean(pw_fc),
      median_log2fc = median(pw_fc),
      wilcox_p     = wt$p.value,
      direction    = if_else(mean(pw_fc) > 0, "Up", "Down")
    )
  }) %>%
    mutate(wilcox_fdr = p.adjust(wilcox_p, method = "BH")) %>%
    arrange(wilcox_p)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: qea-results
#| echo: true

# Run QEA for both timepoints
qea_9m  <- run_metabolite_qea(met_9m)
qea_15m <- run_metabolite_qea(met_15m)

cat("--- 9m QEA top 15 pathways ---\n")
qea_9m %>%
  head(15) %>%
  dplyr::select(pathway, n, mean_log2fc, wilcox_p, wilcox_fdr, direction) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 4)
```

## Figure 5: Metabolite QEA Comparison (9m vs 15m)

We compare QEA results across timepoints, highlighting pathways significant
at either or both ages.

```{r}
#| label: fig-qea-comparison
#| echo: true
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 8

# Merge QEA results across timepoints
qea_9m_sel <- qea_9m %>%
  filter(wilcox_p < 0.1) %>%
  dplyr::select(pathway, n_9m = n, mean_log2fc_9m = mean_log2fc,
                wilcox_p_9m = wilcox_p, dir_9m = direction)

qea_15m_sel <- qea_15m %>%
  filter(wilcox_p < 0.1) %>%
  dplyr::select(pathway, n_15m = n, mean_log2fc_15m = mean_log2fc,
                wilcox_p_15m = wilcox_p, dir_15m = direction)

# Union of pathways significant at either timepoint
qea_compare <- full_join(qea_9m_sel, qea_15m_sel, by = "pathway") %>%
  replace_na(list(wilcox_p_9m = 1, wilcox_p_15m = 1)) %>%
  mutate(
    neg_log10p_9m  = -log10(pmax(wilcox_p_9m, 1e-10)),
    neg_log10p_15m = -log10(pmax(wilcox_p_15m, 1e-10)),
    pathway = fct_reorder(pathway, neg_log10p_15m)
  )

# Reshape for paired barplot
qea_plot_data <- qea_compare %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(neg_log10p_9m, neg_log10p_15m),
    names_to = "timepoint", values_to = "neg_log10p"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    timepoint_label = if_else(timepoint == "neg_log10p_9m",
                              "9 Months", "15 Months"),
    dir = if_else(timepoint == "neg_log10p_9m",
                  replace_na(dir_9m, "NA"), replace_na(dir_15m, "NA")),
    fill_col = case_when(
      dir == "Up"   ~ "#d95f02",
      dir == "Down" ~ "#1b9e77",
      TRUE          ~ "#999999"
    )
  ) %>%
  replace_na(list(neg_log10p = 0))

ggplot(qea_plot_data,
       aes(x = neg_log10p, y = pathway, fill = fill_col,
           alpha = timepoint_label)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -log10(0.05), color = "red",
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("9 Months" = 0.5, "15 Months" = 0.85),
                     name = "Timepoint") +
  labs(
    title = "Metabolite Pathway QEA: 9 vs 15 Months",
    subtitle = "Wilcoxon rank-sum test, Rps2-A226Y vs WT, Liver",
    x = expression(-log[10] * "(p-value)"),
    y = NULL
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = -log10(0.05) + 0.1, y = 0.5,
           label = "p = 0.05", color = "red", size = POST_LABEL_SIZE, hjust = 0) +
  theme_post() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

# Create output directory for this script

saveRDS(met_15m, file.path(output_dir, "met_15m_clean.rds"))

saveRDS(tx_15m,  file.path(output_dir, "tx_15m_clean.rds"))

saveRDS(pw_summary_9m,  file.path(output_dir, "pw_summary_9m.rds"))
saveRDS(pw_summary_15m, file.path(output_dir, "pw_summary_15m.rds"))

saveRDS(qea_15m, file.path(output_dir, "qea_15m.rds"))
